headline: Ibovespa Closes Higher Lifted by Oil Prices Amid Fiscal Cautiousness
summary: Brazil's Ibovespa index closed up 0.31 per cent at 169,816.64 points, supported by rising oil prices, though investor caution regarding fiscal policy limited broader recovery.
why: Domestic equity index movements reflect commodity price fluctuations and investor sentiment regarding government fiscal deficit management.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Higher oil prices provide support for heavyweight index constituents, driving the benchmark index higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Gains in oil prices supported energy-related index components, allowing the benchmark index to close in positive territory despite fiscal concerns.
